exposure: Middle cerebral artery pulsatility index (MCA PI)
low middle cerebral artery pulsatility index (MCA PI)
low fetal weight appropriate for gestational age
cohort: 150 low-risk pregnant women scheduled for elective cesarean sections at 39 weeks of gestation
finding: Low CPR and low MCA PI were significantly associated with decreased cord arterial pH, lower Apgar scores at 5 minutes, and increased NICU admissions in appropriate-for-gestational-age fetuses.
mod_finding: This study focused on the association between cerebroplacental ratio and neonatal outcomes in women undergoing elective cesarean sections and did not involve other delivery methods.
